result.title: On Johnson-Lindenstrauss Transforms for Byzantine-Robust Optimization
result.summary: The growing scale of data and models in machine learning calls for efficient optimization methods. Distributed optimization addresses this challenge, with compression mechanisms helping to reduce communication costs. A classical tool for dimensionality reduction is the Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL) transform, which is simple to implement and offers strong geometric guarantees. In particular, JL transforms approximately preserve inner products and pairwise distances between vectors with high probability. In this paper, we exploit this property in Byzantine-robust optimization, where worker messages are weighted according to their alignment with a trusted reference gradient. We further support our theoretical findings with experimental results.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究 Byzantine-robust 分布式优化，利用 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 变换近似保持内积与成对距离的性质，按 worker 消息与可信参考梯度的对齐程度进行加权，并给出理论分析与实验。
AI.relevance_reason: JL 随机投影可低廉近似内积与距离，或可供核查作为 latent 状态相似度计算的降维代理；按与可信参考方向的对齐度加权筛选消息，也可能类比于 latent 证据筛选与贡献分配，但论文本身面向分布式优化鲁棒聚合，与 LVR 无直接关系。
